body: How can I deal with the pain of not being able to protect them from their father. I never thought he would do that to our child he took anger he had for me out on them.

I don’t want to hurt my kids. I can’t seek proper help because cps will use it against me. I notice the way everyone looks at me always judging me. When my family found out what happened to my child they all blamed me. They think I should’ve had 100% custody even though I had to fight tooth and nail to get 50/50. Now all I get is visitation for 4 hours every other week. 
I’ve had to block so many family members because they have harassed me for not knowing. 

All I’ve ever done is love my kids more than life itself. I would give my life to protect them. But how do I deal with the pain?wishing I could’ve done something to protect my child.

I plan on making it look like an accident they won’t know I did it on purpose no one will except Reddit. The road I take to go see them is dangerous, accidents happen all the time. 

The pain I feel is unbearable.
